notes.title: Update v1.2 Scoreboard!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34312196/4357353e2edfc30ec3d60d506fa585599a90d731.jpg[/img]

[b]Game under treatment. [/b]

- Online scoreboard added. Show off without shame. 
- Characters name pool increased. Now you have more names to yell.

[b]Fix notes:[/b]

-Changed score calculation for lives game mode. We learned to count on this one. 

-Bug fix, when a doctor is turning mad and being abducted he will actually be abducted. THANK YOU ALIENS ːsteamfacepalmː

Now get in there and show us what you got!

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34312196/46563b4a37c79a8e148fd50314cc49613f913aa7.png[/img]

Game under treatment, now it has updates.
Update v1.1 Notes:

[b]Added:[/b]

- German and Spanish Language added. Ahora puedes enloquecer en tu idioma original. Sie können in Ihrer Originalsprache verrückt werden.

- Alien profile added to selection interface. Aliens profile’s matters.

- Outline indicator added when you select an inactive sane or a doctor for 2 seconds. Now you have a better idea of what's going on.

- Music and SFX equalizer added in the pause menu. new and shiny scroll for the music and sound effects.

[b]Fix notes:[/b]

-Fixed selection ring. Was positioned wrongly sometimes. it was a hard fight, the ring won.

-Fixed blend animation idle to walk mad. mad walking watch out.

-Fixed countdown sound, in some levels didn't sound. now you know you are doom on each level.

-Fixed bug loonies were able to walk through psychiatric workstation in some levels. this would have not being an issue if they were a ghost.

-Score needed for 3 star in level 21 changed from 20.000 to 17.000. now we can actually win this.

-Changed score needed for lvl 21 events. yay events!

-Workstations lay out of level 11 changed. play that level and check it by yourself .

Minor bugs fixed. they feel insignificant since we didn’t list them here ːsteamfacepalmː .This is not even our final form! we will be adding more updates on the future, if you have any bugs or error please tell us at the community thread.Thanks for playing.

notes.title: Insanus Express Launch!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings crazy patients.[/b]

It is Launch Day, and our best coding doctors are almost Insanus!
As for the 1.0 version of Insanus Express we will only have English as the base language. Spanish, French, German, Italian and Portuguese versions will be released next week.

With future updates we will add some interesting features like;

- Challenge Mode
- Achievements
- Scoreboard

And more...

Thanks for your patience and remember, Once you go mad, you never go back![img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34312196/22389e14f6cd4e57bf8999ce207ebd55aa1502e8.jpg[/img]
